nom: L'Oréal Age Perfect Serum Le Duo

avis.texte: This is a fantastic serum and for the price, it's an easy repurchase! My husband in particular love it because it offers multiple benefits in one step and absorbs face. The only reason I gave 4 instead of 5 stars is because if you are sensitive to floral or strong scents - this may not be for you.

avis.titre: Great product, but not enough of it
avis.texte: First of all, I love the Le Duo (and the smell). But for almost $40, I would expect it to last longer than a month. That's right, used it once in the am and once in the pm, and it was gone in a month. There really needs to be more product in the bottle. I never had the $$ to try Clarins Double Serum, so can't compare it, but the Le Duo feels great, gave my skin a nice glow, and I really love the fragrance. I was just really shocked that I ran out of it so quickly. There is no way I can afford to keep using this, sadly.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Was unsure at first because I have sensitive skin that breaks out easily. Pleasantly surprised, feels nice on the skin and soaks in quickly. Did not break me out, which I was very worried that it would. My skin feels nice after applying it. I dont have many lines or wrinkles, so nothing to report as far as improvement on that. Just looking to help prolong the aging of my face. I do like it though. I would recommend and may purchase in the future.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] First I like the packaging, makes it look and feel so luxurious, plus you can see the product inside as well. I'm a fan of dual formulas serums, I think they're a fantastic addition to any skincare routine, but this I especially loved due to the fact that we get a collage peptide serum, along with a vitamin B3 & C one and when they come together, they make an exquisite almost milky-like consistency that feels lightweight, absorbs well, and makes my skin look so glowy ✨ it does have a light scent that doesn't linger. Honestly one pump of product might be enough for the entire face and neck.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I would say this is a good product if you are looking for something more affordable. I was surprised by the bottle being a light plastic, not what I had expected. It is scented so if you don't like that, this wouldn't be the product for you.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This serum has a nice consistency and pleasant smell. I'm not sure if it's added fragrance. It makes my skin feel soft and moisturized. I have been using it for nearly a month now. I'm not seeing any significant reduction in lines but my skin does feel more firm.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Decent quality and nice two-tone texture. The look and feel of the product is light yet glossy and leave skin with a nice finish. Don't know the price is worthy of the quality with other products out there where I've seen more visible results but a good option for a quick night time moisturizer!

avis.titre: If the price is right for you try it
avis.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] It feels so good on my skin ! I am not sure if it helped with my wrinkles, I probably need to use it longer. But if the price works for you why not try it .

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I love the weight of this. It's very light and does not make my face greasy. It keeps my skin moisturized and doesn't sting when you put it on. The smell is great too. I have definitely noticed a difference in the texture of my skin since using.

avis.titre: I love the results, but the scent is strong and lingers
avis.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This serum is interesting. It took a bit for the pump to pull product evenly, but it's a cool concept. I didn't care for the scent of the serum, as I typically don't like scented products for my face. This one unfortunately lingers for quite awhile, and it's fairly strong (and very perfume-y). I wish that it didn't have a scent because it does work well, my skin feels very hydrated and it has helped my skin appear smoother. Unfortunately though, the scent is enough for me not to continue using this serum because I can't stand it.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This age perfect serum duo is amazing. The aroma of a nice clean smell is wonders to your sense of smell will applying. Produce comes out evenly and the same amounts. Now is a real staple in my skin care routine

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This cream is creamy and feels luxurious on your skin. It is not too thick and can rub on skin and absorb on to skin very easily without any greasy residue.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] The L'Oreal Paris Age Perfect Serum Le Duo is a clever two-in-one serum that combines hydration and anti aging benefits in a single pump. The dual formula feels lightweight, absorbs quickly, and leaves skin looking smoother and more radiant without feeling greasy.Overtime it helps improve texture and adds a glow.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] After using this, I didn't see any difference in my skin other than breakouts. I felt my skin was MORE dry after using it. The serum does have a nice texture to it, and the scent isn't strong. The bottle was okay, but it felt kind of cheap being plastic. The pump did disperse an even amount and it was easy to use. Overall, I don't think my skin liked it.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] The dosage is perfect. The serum comes out evenly. I love the packaging. It absorbs well and smells good and feels good on the skin. The product is easy to use.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This is a great product! It wears well under makeup. There is no pilling at all. It also leaves the skin glowing! The consistency is great blends into the skin with ease. I like that the scent isn't overwhelming and what scent there is doesn't last. Love love it!

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I dont think it leaves any residue as for absorption is acceptable as for packaging it's good as for value I will still get it as for application is all manageable

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I really love how this serum feels on the skin. It is very smooth and sinks in fast with no residue or tackiness and leaves my skin feeling plump and hydrated! So far I haven't experienced any irritation and I do have sensitive skin. The dual chambers actually pump out evenly compared to similar products where one side comes out more than the other. Looking forward to see what this can do for my skin!

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Was not impressed, felt nice on the skin and had no heavy scent. Didn't work very well either. Had a breakout pretty quickly after use, do not recommend.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I like the packaging on this serum. It's sleek and pretty. I appreciate that this a duo serum. This serum helps with firmness, cell renewal, and visible wrinkles. There are 10 benefits to this serum and I love that. My skin feels soft and glowy after using this. I will keep using this one.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Really loving this product! My skin feels so smooth nourished and radiant. I use it as a part of my skin care routine and haven't had a problem with adding makeup on top of it. Says to use twice daily so be sure to do so! Product claims that skin looks younger around eight weeks so I'm looking forward to seeing those results. I can definitely say skin is plump and bright at around a few weeks use. You get both that milky serum and shimmer with each pump!

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This is an amazing skin product that I was very unsure about when I got it but I was very surprised how it made my skin feel and look. I would highly recommend this product you will love it

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] LOVE! I love the scent and love how it makes my skin feel afterwards. Little bit goes a long way if you put too much on your face, you'll end up getting a bit of a peeling fact around the eyebrow area, but the product itself is really great. The packaging is nice at first glance, but it's plastic, which makes it feel cheap.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I have been applying every day for more than a month L'Oreal Paris Age perfect Serum Le Duo on my face, it leaves a sensation of a smoother, nourished, hydrated skin, really feels like a nutritious experience. I have even noticed softer wrinkles. I love the presentation, super easy to use, just with two pumps is the perfect quantity volume for my face and neck. I'm absolutely fascinated by it!

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This serum has been a great addition to my nightly routine. Very hydrating, a little shimmer, and easily absorbs. The smell is a little off putting to me but disappears quickly. I like the dual serum applicator.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This serum did NOT agree with my skin. I used it once on my face and broke out in a rash within 24 hours. I have sensitive skin and acne prone skin. It is heavily fragranced and one pump dispenses way more product than you need. On the bright side, the bottle is big and the glow is nice so I will use this as a body serum.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I was happy to begin using L'Oréal Age Perfect Serum! I used to use the predecessor of this product a couple of years ago and forgot how much I like it. My skin felt really moisturized and smoother. The scent is really subtle and I just love the way the product dispenses. I'm a fan all over again and will add this to my skin care regimen.

I received this product in exchange for my honest review. L'Oreal serum le duo blends skincare and make up in one step. Lightweight, smooth, and gives a natural glow while evening out skin tone. Perfect for quick, polished everyday looks.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] L'Oréal's Age Perfect Age-Defying Serum Le Duo has a very cool looking dual-chamber design, that mix two formulas together to target mature skin concerns like loss of firmness, dryness, and uneven tone. The texture feels lightweight and absorbs quickly without leaving a greasy residue. I like it for layering under moisturizer or makeup. I feel like it instantly improves my skins softness and hydration. Im hoping that with consistent long term use, the serum can help my skin look more supple and slightly firmer. And hopefully help with lines and wrinkles

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I love all of Loreal products but this serum le duo is incredible. I like how it feels on the skin and i would definitely recommend this product to all my friends

avis.titre: Luxury skincare for a fraction of the price
avis.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Overall this product is very good. It absorbs quickly and leaves my skin feeling smooth. The scent is light and pleasant, and it feels like a much more expensive product on the skin. I will say the packaging isn't my favorite, I thought the plastic came off a bit cheap but the product is nice.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I appreciate the convenience this container provides. The anti-aging benefits are all things I'm looking for and comes at a decent price. I just don't love the plastic container!

avis.titre: Good Product With Some Design Drawbacks
avis.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I've been using this for some weeks now, and while I dont notice a significant change in the appearance of my skin, it does make it feel much softer after use. I like the dual product nature of this, anything to make my routine more efficient! I will say, this does have quite a strong fragrance, so if you're sensitive to that this may be an issue. I also didn't realize initially that the two product sections have an opaque coloring on them, so it's impossible to tell exactly how much product is left. That is slightly annoying. Overall a good product though!

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This is one of the best serums I've ever used in any price point! I love how smooth and soft my skin feels after I use it. It smells divine and is so easy to store because it's oval shaped. Literally L'Oreal did everything right with this!

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I'm always looking for products that maximize benefits while simplifying my routine. The serum duo does exactly that by combining essential vitamins my skin needs with the visual benefits of rejuvenating collagen peptides. The product absorbs nicely in my skin.

avis.titre: Good formula, not my favorite packaging.
avis.texte: I received this product for free in exchange for my honest review. I don't typically use drugstore brands in my skincare routine but this seemed like a higher end item to try. The two serums in one was an interesting concept to address different skin concerns. The pump on the product was easy to press and consistently delivers the same amount of product every time. The cap stays attached securely so I would feel comfortable traveling with this. The two serums mixed well together and had a pretty thin texture overall. It layered well with my other skincare routine products, absorbed quickly, and didn't cause me any issues with sensitivity. I don't love that you can't see how much product is left in the package, and it seems like it will be hard to get open to get the last dregs of product out when it's almost gone. I didn't notice a significant change in my skin over the time I used this, but since I have a pretty serious skincare routine already with a lot of higher-end products, I consider the fact that my skin didn't backslide to be a positive sign. Depending on the price I may or may not purchase this again, the effects were fine but I would prefer a product that I can see how much is left in and that is easier to open up when it's running out.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I am loving this product!! It makes my skin har a nice and subtle glow. It soaks in very well and quickly. There is not much of a scent, which I personally like.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This serum has really helped the overall appearance of my face- less redness, skin texture more smooth etc. it doesn't cause me any irritation and I feel that it does give me firmer skin.

avis.titre: Great but the pump isn't my fave
avis.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Surprisingly, I actually really like this product. I didn't think I would see much of a difference, so expectations were set accordingly. The packaging is fun with the two chambers, but I'm not a huge fan of the pump. It doesn't distribute the product evenly & takes a few pumps to get both sides to dispense. The product itself smells lovely & glides on nicely. I feel like my skin is much more hydrated after using it.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Thr older I get the more I really appreciate a good drugstore brand and L'Oreal is always at the top of my list. This age perfect serum le duo is so cool to dispense first and foremost. With two different concoctions meeting in thr middle to dispense, its fun to watch. Then rubbing together and applying to my face, my skin instantly felt hydrated and satin-y smooth! There is little to not scent. As im nearing the end of thr bottle, I just really love the night and day difference in how bright my complexion is! Im so glowy I just love it! Classic iconic packaging, affordable and readily available!

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I fell in love with this serum it feels amazing on my skin and smells really nice. It absorbs quickly and goes on super soft and silky and not sticky or greasy. It does have a stronger scent but I really love it and it doesn't bother me or burn my skin. I've really noticed a change in the appearance and feel of my skin since using this. My skin feels really soft, smooth, and hydrated. My skin definitely looks younger and more healthy and feels better while using this serum. I definitely recommend this and I will continue using it as long as it's available to purchase.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This serum is lightweight and feels silky when applying it but absorbs into my skin quickly and sits nicely under my makeup as well. The packaging is sleek and the pump dispenses an equal amount of both serums and when mixed together one pump is enough to cover my skin.

avis.titre: It's ok but it could improve
avis.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] You need to pump a few times to get both sides to come out evenly which I feel like makes you waste some of fhe product on the white side a little bit. I had to stop using it because I was having a reaction with one of my eyes. Mind you I didn't even have the product anywhere near. I tested it on my head and cheeks. I knew it was this thought because it seemed to act up when I'd use it. This is just my personally experience though. It doesn't mean this isn't good. Another thing though I wasn't crazy about is the sent. You don't need to have that much or any at all in a skin care product. Especially on your face. It was like a strong lavender.I really did want to enjoy this! I noticed it did help with some of my fine lines as I was using it. It also feels so soft and moisturizing on your skin. I overall don't think its a bad product but it really wasn't for me.

avis.titre: Yaya for hydration and that glow
avis.texte: I received this product I return for my honest review. This is probably hands one of the best drug store serums out there currently. L'Oréal really knows how to make top notch products for affordable prices - although this is a little on the higher end but worth it. I would 100% recommend anyone purchasing this. I have also tried other serums that retails for triple this price but I feel like this works exactly like the ones I used for more $. After using this serum for a month straight my skin feels so soft l, glows and it definitely looks a webit more tightened. I will definitely continue to use and purchase. This is a great product! thanks L'Oréal!

I was recently selected to try this Amazing Serum Le Duo by Loreal. This serum has the best silky smooth texture that absorbs quickly, leaving my face glowing smooth. I have sensitive skin; this serum is gentle and left me with no breakouts, just radiant looking skin. I'm happy I was able to try it, and it has become my favorite.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Love this product. Extremely hydrating and thick. I use it daily at night before bed and have seen a difference in 4 weeks. I would recommend. The only thing is that the scent is artificial.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This L'Oreal le duo serum works really good. It feels soft and thin and moisturizing on your face and absorbs in quickly so now have residue. Skin feels tighter and firmer.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I love this drugstore option for my serum. Since using it I've noticed that some of the tiny fine lines I have under my eyes and on my forehead are smoother. The serum absorbs into my skin quickly too. The packaging is nice and it isn't too heavy to travel with.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I'm a big fan of duo serums and I'm happy L'Oreal has rolled out a more affordable version to reach a broader audience. Similar to other formulas with this concept, the Vitamin C is kept in a separate tube from the aging serum and mix together after you dispense a pump in your hand. I feel like this really keeps the two formulas from diluting each other and ensures you get an equal portion of both serums each time you use. I recently had issues with my skin barrier being slightly damaged so I eased into use very slowly, starting with only applying Le Duo twice a week and only advancing to daily a month in. I did not have any issues with inflammation or redness while using this product. After a month I didn't see dramatic changes but I did see some lightening of a fairly sizable dark spot under my eye. Overall a good serum for the price point.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Great product Very lightweight, great absorption!! You can see the difference on the looks of your skin also a reduction on the dark spots and the fine lines. Good for sensitive skin , you can used everyday without irritation . You just need a little bit of the product to cover your whole face , the consistency is a key part to see the results needed ! You can find the product in Ulta and the loreal website

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Great budget friendly serum. This is smooth, smells fresh, & easy to apply. I've been using morning & night & feel it gives my skin a smoothing & shiny appearance. It feels high end but is affordable. I'm continuing to use to see if it can help more with aging skin but overall I like using this product & will continue. I'd recommend!

Ok so I actually really love this because there are lots of anti aging options at the drugstore but most of it is rich cream based. Im still combo oily and those other creams can break me out or just worsen my oil production. This serum duo is the best of both worlds. Not too thick but sinks in the skin and absorbs. My skin feels plump and its easy... no thinking and perfect for those nights your too exhausted for a multi step rountine.I received this product in exchange for my honest review

avis.titre: Great dupe for luxury product options
avis.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This is a great dupe product for the 2-1 Clarins serum. I like that it's multi faceted as an exfoliant as well as a vitamin c. I prefer to use at night, as it does make my skin redder, though my baseline is already pretty red.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I love this serum! I love that this is two serums in one! I love that it doesn't have any fragrance! It really absorbs well into the skin, leaves a glass like healthy skin look! Really great price too!

avis.titre: I would buy this product again and again
avis.texte: Wow, L'Oreal paris is definitely #1 skincare company. While container could be glass and not plastic, it has a great potential being the newest and latest technology. Mixing 2 different ingredients right before the use, is a great and very good idea. Serum very soft and gets in the skin very quick, it also leaves gorgeous golden tint, which stays overnight. Skin looks amazing after using this serum and after weeks of use, i can say it works and works great. Day & night use. I received this product for free for my review.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I used L'Oréal Paris Age Perfect Serum Le Duo twice a day for 30 days and saw a beautiful difference. My fine lines looked softer, pores seems smaller, and my skin had this nice glow. My makeup looked better too. It feels lightweight, not greasy, and just made my skin look healthier overall. Highly recommend.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Big fan of this serum! While I haven't seen any long-term effects yet, I am very pleased with the immediate benefits. First, the application is very simple - there is one pump, which evenly pumps both serums at once. The product smells light and fresh, almost a bit like baby shampoo (in a good way!) When applied to the skin, the serum duo has a very silky, velvety feel and soaks into the skin well, leaving no annoying residue. The serum also has a subtle sparkle to it, which gives skin a healthy glow. My only drawback so far is the quality of the packaging - the bottle is a cheap-feeling plastic that does not match the vibe of the product at all. I would expect a slightly nicer bottle for this quality of product.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I'm loving the luxurious look and feel of Age Perfect Serum Le Duo by L'Oréal Paris. It is packaged like a luxury product in a sleek pump style bottle with rich, golden coloring that appears very pretty on my vanity counter, but it's reasonably priced and a great value. Enriched with Vitamins B3, C and a Skin Renewing Complex, I love the idea of two effective serums being kept fresh and separate until the moment of use. Sadly, the bottles pump dispenser is difficult to use and does not distribute equal amounts of both serums with each pump and occasionally only one serum will comes out per pump. When the two serums mix, they are creamy and absorb quickly into my dry, mature skin providing immediate hydration without any greasy residue. I really appreciate that this product is dermatologist tested and hasn't irritated my skin or caused any problems with clogging of my pores. The serum does have a light floral like fragrance which is pleasant and dissipates quickly. I'm entering my 4th week of my complimentary product trial and am noticing that my surface skin is feeling firmer, my fine lines are becoming lighter and I am seeing an improved skin tone with increased radiance, which I love! I am excited to continue using this product to see what longer term effects will occur. I do recommend L'Oréal Serum Le Duo, it's formulated for all skin types.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] The perfect serum does exist now! Reminds me of a very pricey product with the packaging. A little bit goes a long way and makes my skin feel soft and smooth. This helped with texture tremendously.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I love that this has vitamin c and a pearly, glowy finish. I started to use this in the mornings, underneath my sunscreen of course. I find that my skin tone looks a little better instantly, due to the pearly finish. The two serums come out and combine. I did notice that you need to have the bottle upright in order to get an even "dose" to come out of the pump, but I didn't feel that was such a problem to deduct a star. The bottle looks luxurious. I did notice notice any irritation or dryness in my skin since using. Overall, this is a good serum for a good value.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Very hydrating serum. I don't find it irritating my sensitive skin at all. The packaging is interesting. I see it is 2 different serums, each in their own chambers, and when you press down to pump it out, they come out together where you can then mix it up before applying on your face. But keep in mind, it'll take a few pumps to get it to come out at the same time. And with any skin care, it'll take at least 2-3 months to see results. So far for me, I've used it for a month straight and it's just been pretty hydrating and didn't cause any breakouts so I will continue using it. Looking forward to great results.

avis.titre: I would repurchase this serum again
avis.texte: I received this product in exchange for my honest review. I have been applying this serum in the morning before my makeup. It layers beautifully under makeup without pilling. It's a light weight serum that leaves your skin feeling silky and hydrated. The duo sided pump distributes equal amounts of product. I have not seen any long term effects that it claims, like reduced wrinkles and younger looking skin since I have only been using it for 3 weeks. Overall, I'm happy with this serum and will continue using it.

I received this product in exchange for my honest review. I have been applying this serum in the morning before my makeup. It layers beautifully under makeup without pilling. It's a light weight serum that leaves your skin feeling silky and hydrated. The duo sided pump distributes equal amounts of product. I have not seen any long term effects that it claims, like reduced wrinkles and younger looking skin since I have only been using it for 3 weeks. Overall, I'm happy with this serum and will continue using it.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I've used this for a few weeks straight on my face and neck, am & pm, and I haven't really noticed any positive difference. It smells nice and I didn't break out. I'll continue to use it on my face until it's done (I've recently become uncomfortable using it on my neck/thyroid due to the ingredients pertaining to parfum/fragrance). To be completely honest, I'm not blown away by it, but maybe I just need to give it more time.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I received the L'Oreal Paris Age Perfect Age-Defying Serum Le Duo in exchange for my honest review. I am in love with this serum! It contains Vitamins B3 and C, plus a Skin Renewing Complex. After my first use, I noticed a difference. My skin was so much smoother, had a glowing complexion and hydration. This serum feels amazing on my skin and it does have a fragrance, but it doesn't irritate or smell bad at all, plus it fades quickly. I was shocked by how quickly this absorbs into my skin, giving it a hydrated, luminous look while leaving my face silky smooth. I love that it's not greasy at all and it's non-comedogenic! The great thing is that this has been dermatologist tested and is suitable for even sensitive skin. For the first application, pump the center of the dispenser until the 2 formulas appear evenly. You use this every morning and night, followed by sunscreen during the day and moisturizer at night. Overall, I cannot say enough good things about this serum and will definitely continue to use!

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] The fragrance is light and when the two serums are mixed the texture is a little oily but it absorbs quickly. I felt the slightest tingle for a little bit, but not for long. It actually helped me recover from a skin reaction I'd had to something I ate, which was a pleasant surprise. It really helped with hydration and repairing the skin barrier. I will continue using this to help my skin keep healing.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I'm very happy With the serum. It made my skin feel so plump. It absorbed into my skin beautifully and it reminds me of a high-end face cream. I've used it for about four weeks now and I've noticed a beautiful brightening of my skin. I like that. It has two in one distribution, I would definitely purchase this on my own.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This is a duo age defying seum. This product is so easy to use as it comes in a pump that releases the exact amount of duo product for application. I did think it was a tad bit watery for application, but does not leave my face tacky at all. I did think this left my skin moisturized and just a bit plumper. I did receive this product free in exchange for my honest review.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I've been consistently using this product for a few weeks now and like it as a serum before moisturizing. The scent is STRONG for people who are sensitive to that. It's a perfume scent that I wonder if it's necessary to the product. I am not sensitive to scent but noticed it right away. I like the texture and that 1 pump does enough to cover my face. 2 pumps would cover neck and face

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I really enjoyed using this product and may start buying it. It's smells nice but not overly fragranced. I love they combined niacinamide and vitamin C, before I was using two products spots nice to have it in one. The serum is thin, but mighty. My skin feels smother and plumper. I don't notice my pores being clogged. Starting this I've revived a lot of compliments in my skin.

I've been using this consistently the past several weeks. I've noticed a difference in the tone of my skin for sure. It's moisturizing but not too heavy and soaks into the skin like silk. I give it 4 stars because of the fragrance, it's a little too perfumey for me.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] The serum applies easily. No greasy/oily feel. I applied it to my face and neck and it absorbed quickly. Skin felt nice, but I didn't see any difference in lines or dark spots. Washed off easily and no irritation on my skin.

avis.titre: I would definitely buy this product
avis.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I really like the L'Oreal Paris Age Perfect Le Duo Serum. It absorbs really fast and doesn't feel greasy or oily at all. It has a light scent but smells really good. It's hard to describe, maybe a light fruity floral fragrance. I love how they kept the two serums separate in the bottle. Looks expensive! My skin loves it and I would definitely recommend it to everyone.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] The L'Oréal Paris Age Perfect Serum Le Duo has made a noticeable difference over the weeks in my skin's brightness, plumpness, hydration, and firmness. I look more radiant and fine lines are less noticeable. I love how the two serums come together in each pump, delivering a potent blend of niacinamide, Vitamin C, Vitamin B3, and collagen peptides. I use 2x a day after toner and then followed by SPF moisturizer during the day and night cream in the evening. There is a subtle pleasant scent; the serum absorbs easily without any tacky feeling

Interesting product. I suspect the double-barrel dispenser is needed because the acids from one side would destabilize the other ingredients; still I kind of wish it was dispensed in a more controllable way so you don't get so much product per pump. I've been on a hunt for a Creme de La Mer dupe, and this serum is one of the closest products I've found to it so far, with regards to what it's meant to do and how the formulation operates. But, unhappily, this has something really irritating in it (I'm inclined to guess too much vitamin C) and it just makes the product itch so much on my skin that I can't stand it. I had to return it after 2 days -- I don't care if it's a perfect match I just can't live with the itching. Perhaps if you don't have sensitive skin, it's endurable. For me it was just too painful. Too bad -- because my skin looked really good with it. Yes I would recommend to a friend who didn't have sensitive skin.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I received this L'Ore Paris Age Perfection Serum Le Duoas as a complimentary gift for an honest review. The packaging is perfect. I love how the product feels in the skin and how it makes your skin look illuminated. I gave it 4 stars because the product itself was a bit watery on one side, but it's still a great product. I would recommend seeking a serum that can help fight the appearance of aging.

I love how this delivers 2 serums in 1 pump. One serum is milky and hydrating the other delivers Vitamin C and other vitamins that will brighten your skin, I could easily spend hundreds of dollars for similar serums.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Love the idea of a clear and milky serum in one. Me skin felt smooth and moisturized after applying it, but I still added my regular moisturizer over it. Felt good, but the scent was a little much for me.

I do find if I layer it with too many things it makes me makeup pill, so I have only been wearing it at night. My skin feel smooth when I wear it. I really like it and will continue to use.

avis.titre: Good, but can be harsh on sensitive skin
avis.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This serum is good for brightening the skin. It is easy to pump and apply. I like that it provides two different products in one easy to use bottle. I did notice some mild burning on the first few applications, so I would avoid this product if you have really sensitive skin. I wish the box had more information on it about the types of serums that are in included in the bottle. It would have provided me with a little more insight as to what exactly I was putting on my face. However, I do notice a nice difference in my skin when used a few times a week.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] After a few days of using this beauty and good product, I can tell you how good it is for your skin. This Loreal age perfect serum duo is very hydrated, very fast absorption and non greasy at all. The skin feels smooth and firm. This serum smells very good. The package is very cute and very easy to use. I love the design to separate the product in 2 tubes and came out together but separate, and then you mixed it.

I received this product in exchange for my honest review.I really enjoyed the all around texture and feeling of both serums on my face. The creamier serum has collagen to help improve cell renewal to improve hydration, firmness and smooth wrinkles. The gold size has B3 and Vitamin C to boost radiance and even tone. There is a light scent to it as well. I love being able to layer two serums together for more skin benefits.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This 2-in-1 serum is very unique and I love how the two formulas are kept separate. This helps you get the perfect amount of each one and it makes the bottle look so pretty and unique. I've definitely never seen anything like this before. One of the serums is nice and milky and the other one is more clear and oily but without being greasy, and they absorb into the skin well. With peptides and multiple vitamins, including Vitamin C, this is perfect for keeping your skin looking plump and youthful. After just a couple weeks of using it in the morning I can already tell my skin is looking more glowy and fresh. The only downside is that it is heavily perfumed and you can definitely smell it on your face after applying. If you're someone who is sensitive to perfumes I would not recommend this product. I don't mind perfumes so much so it's fine for me, but it's definitely a strong scent.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Omg this stuff smells amazing - I would seriously wear it just for the smell. Very lightweight product here that has a gorgeous glow which I love for pre make up application!

avis.titre: A bit disappointing, for a few reasons…
avis.texte: I was hopeful that I would like this product, but it has a few caveats that I can't ignore. First off, it's highly fragranced which, for a skin care item that is for your face, should actually be as fragrance free as possible. Secondly, while the package is pretty, the amount of actual contents in the bottle is compromised since the fancy designed bottle only allows for two small little tube shaped areas for the two different kind of product in the bottle. And, finally, the product itself is two different lotions/serums that are supposed to pump out together side by side through two exit holes at the top of the pump dispenser…but, I have rarely got both products to dispense at the same time…usually, only one will come out (with my bottle it's usually the lotion part that comes out) while the serum takes a few more pumps from the top to appear…this is is a design flaw with the pumping mechanism. I haven't noticed much of a difference in my skin yet, but I will say I like the way the product feels going on my face. It's just hard to get past the fragrance scent when applying…I recommend this if you care more about the fancy looks of the packaging of beauty products more than what they can do, but other then that, this item needs some work. I received this incentivized product in exchange for my honest review.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] First I am on love with the bottle - it looks like a professional salon grade product. The light scent is so intriguing and feels so smooth when applying. I am so amazed by the value of this serum.

Love this serum so much. It is very powerful but not thick and gloppy feeling. It applies like a dream and effortlessly. I love how it makes my skin feel tighter and more supple. [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] At first glance, the look of the box and photos of the product make it look very lux but the minute I opened it and got the bottle out I felt like it looked like a cheap bottle in cheap plastic. [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I have used alot of face serums, this one was honestly MID for me. [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] While I would love to do a follow up on the serum in a few months, my initial impression is very positive. I'm an esthetician, accomplished and experienced. I've had more experience with high end/professional products. But we are living in a time when we are all cost conscious. Thus far, the L'Oréal Serum LeDuo performs as well ( if not better) than many 'high end' brands. It has a clean, sort of white tea scent that is pleasant, and not overpowering. The ingredients include peptides, Vitamins C and B3, and collagen to hydrate, even skin tone, and smooth fine lines, The 2 serums are separated and mix as pumped. (I'm assuming the separation helps each component maintain integrity.) The serums absorb quickly, leaving skin hydrated and plump. It's non irritating. Thus far, it's impressive! I'd recommend it

avis.titre: Perfect for Tightness after washing your face
avis.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I was so exited to try this! I use this twice a day after washing my face. It's got 10 skincare benefits and my main focus is one- tightness. I use a medicated cleanser or acne and sometimes it leaves my face feeling tight and stripped. It is non-greasy and absorbs quickly so I can move on to my next skincare steps. To apply I find the light tapping method works well. The first time you use it you will need press the pump a few times. But I find the pump delivery method so helpful. I don't like getting my fingers into the cream hard after washing my face. The split containers ensures the serum is potent and the cream is hydrating. Combining it before application gives me the feeling that I'm getting the best of both worlds. I have been using it for 3 weeks now and even with that I still have so much because of the large amount in the container. I want another one since my husband likes it too.

avis.titre: I would buy this again. I love the smell, and they feel.
avis.texte: I received the L'Oreal Paris Age Perfect Serum le Duo free of charge for testing purposes only, in return for my honest and unbiased review. Comes in a very cute bottle with two chambers, one for the serum and one for the lotion like serum. I like that it has a little bit of sparkle to it, because it just makes you look brighter and it also has a very light color to it to give you a healthy glow. But you don't look like you're wearing Foundation. I love the smell of it. It's not too overpowering, but it almost smells like an expensive perfume that is light, sweet, and refreshing. It kind of makes me feel fancy. Hahaha! This serum isn't greasy. It soaks in very well, but still leaves you feeling moisturized. My skin feels more taut; almost revitalized after I wear it. I believe that this serum will last you quite a while because you don't have to use a ton of it, just a couple of pumps. I rubbed it on my face and my neck and patted it in. I put it on morning and night and it didn't appear to get anything on in my pillowcase. This serum did not irritate my skin or break me out. I think it actually helped the fine lines around my lips, because I am going to turn 51 in a couple of months and I need all the help I can get. I like this serum so much that I wore it at home without makeup. Any remaining serum that I had, I rubbed onto my. Hands and they're nice and smooth on top. I definitely recommend this product to family, friends, and anyone not looking to spend a lot of money bu
